title: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts. Make ONE contiguous change inside resolveSubstrateGapWrite
description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts. Make ONE contiguous change inside resolveSubstrateGapWrite.

Immediately after this exact existing line:

      existingIdx = gaps.findIndex((g) => hasClassifiableId(g) && g.status !== "closed" && gapClassKey(g.id) === classKey);

and after the closing brace of the `if` block that contains it, insert a guard that refuses an echoed decomposition.

Behaviour required. When the write would CREATE a new row (existingIdx is still less than zero) and the incoming summary begins with the case-insensitive prefix "investigate and decompose gap ", followed by an id and a colon, then: parse that parent id out of the summary; find the parent row in the already-loaded `gaps` array by exact id; if the parent is absent, do nothing and fall through unchanged. Otherwise compute an "inner body" for both the incoming summary and the parent summary by repeatedly stripping that same decompose prefix (up to ten times, since a parent summary can itself carry one) and trimming. If the incoming inner body is non-empty and is a prefix of the parent inner body, case-insensitively, then return early with shape "structuredError" and a body carrying resolver "substrateGap_write", failure_mode "decompose_child_echoes_parent", and a detail string naming the parent id and both inner-body lengths.

Fall through unchanged in every other case: updates, non-decompose creates, and children that genuinely add text.

Why this is correct and needs no new data: that function already loads the full `gaps` array before deciding create-versus-update in order to dedup by gap class, so the parent row is in hand at that point and no extra read is required. A child whose body is a leading fragment of its parent's body has added nothing, so it cannot be a decomposition. Measured on the live store, 33 of 50 such children are exactly that, clustering at the 400-character truncation point.

Do not change any other behaviour and do not touch any other file.
